test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

As they driven through the dark, twisting lane / down which they had walked earlier, Lucius heard / the whistling of the night air in his ears.

options.text: down which they had walked earlier, Lucius heard
the whistling of the night air in his ears.
As they driven through the dark, twisting lane

solution:
The erroneous part is: **As they driven through the dark, twisting lane**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the past participle form of the verb 'driven' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be the **past tense** '**drove**' to match the past tense context of the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *As they **drove **through the dark, twisting lane down which they had walked earlier, Lucius heard the whistling of the night air in his ears*.
